title: Accidental dictation/speech-to-text transcript inserted into Old_Projects/README.md
summary: Two paragraphs of unrelated speech-to-text transcript were appended to the end of the workspace root README.md. The text was never committed (working-tree only) and has since been removed. This file documents what happened, the evidence trail, and the likely cause.

location.position: appended immediately after line 68 (end of the 'Acknowledgements & Sources' section), with no separating blank line

insertedText.note: Verbatim capture of the removed content, exactly as it appeared. Line 70 was an empty line between the two paragraphs, indicating two separate dictation bursts. Paragraph 1 ended with a trailing space.

evidenceTrail.gitBlame: Lines 69-71 attributed to '00000000 (Not Committed Yet)' — uncommitted local changes only.
evidenceTrail.headState: git show HEAD:README.md ends at line 68 ('...see the Projects table.'). The text is absent from every commit.
evidenceTrail.lastCommitTouchingFile: 52295b1 'Temporary fixed the other projects. Fixed some issues in Dama.' (2026-09-16 16:41:46 +0800)
evidenceTrail.editorArtifacts: No swap/backup/autosave files (.swp, ~, .#*) were present to narrow the source further.

likelyCause.classification: Speech-to-text / dictation transcript, not authored content or a script edit.
likelyCause.reasoning: The content is rambling first-person spoken English about unrelated topics (a stream, brownies, Disney, entertainers becoming friends), contains no markdown or code, and appears as two bursts separated by a blank line. This is characteristic of a voice-dictation input capturing ambient audio.
likelyCause.primeSuspect: Windows dictation (Win+H) on the Windows host, inserting recognized speech at the focused editor's caret while the cursor was parked at the end of README.md. The workspace is Windows -> WSL2 with the file open in the IDE.
likelyCause.certainty: High that it is dictation; the exact application cannot be forensically proven because no logs or swap files survive.

resolution.action: Removed lines 69-71 from README.md, restoring the file to end at the 'Acknowledgements & Sources' section.
resolution.verifiedBy: README.md now ends at the Projects-table reference line; no other content was altered.

prevention: Disable or be mindful of OS-level dictation (Win+H) when an editor is focused.
Review 'git diff' before committing so stray working-tree insertions are caught.
